strings.workflow.operation.d.music.generate.deta: MRT2 encodes pitch, onset, and sustain at 25 Hz (40 ms). Voices on the same pitch merge; nonzero velocity is not encoded, and drums are currently unconstrained. Output is limited to stereo 48 kHz WAV up to 16 seconds, with fixed temperature 1.3, Top-k 40, MusicCoCa CFG 3, and notes/drums CFG 1. Condition following is approximate and does not guarantee exact reproduction.

strings.workflow.musicCapabilities.title: MRT2 fixed capabilities and limits
strings.workflow.musicCapabilities.conditioning: 25 Hz (40 ms) conditioning encodes pitch, onset, and sustain. Voices on the same pitch merge; nonzero velocity is not encoded, and drums are currently unconstrained. Condition following is approximate and does not guarantee exact reproduction.
strings.workflow.musicCapabilities.optionalNotes: When both notes and harmony are absent, note conditioning is unconstrained. With no harmony, an explicitly empty note list sends all-pitches-OFF conditioning rather than omitting conditioning, but does not promise silence. Connected harmony is still merged with note conditioning.
strings.workflow.musicCapabilities.output: Output is limited to stereo 48 kHz WAV up to 16 seconds.
strings.workflow.musicCapabilities.sampling: Fixed sampling: temperature 1.3, Top-k 40, MusicCoCa CFG 3, and notes/drums CFG 1.
